AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL Mayor Argumedo called a Special meeting to order at 9:38 am.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council on a Closed Session agenda items.  

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION City Council recessed to a Closed session at 9:39 a.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council reconvened to an Open Session at 10:35 p.m.

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Arnold Alvarez- Glasman reported on item #1.  TThe City Council instructed the City Attorney to draft an amendment to the Assistant City Manager's Employment Agreement, which has now been agreed upon by both parties. It will be presented to the Council for review.

ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 10:39 a.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.

Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.
